elaine (devex): FYI ran into a weird onboarding snag in the CLI/sampleapp flow — it prefers ORG_API_KEY over PROJECT_TOKEN if both are set, which is surprising and caused cross-project calls for me.

sam (sdk): ouch. is that the env var precedence we documented?

elaine (devex): we document PROJECT_TOKEN higher priority in the quickstart, but the CLI code path that loads cached creds checks ORG_API_KEY first. reproduced in container + local.

jia (platform): can you paste the loader snippet? might be a legacy fallback from the old deploy CLI.

elaine (devex): sure — gist inline: `// pseudo
const key = process.env.ORG_API_KEY || process.env.PROJECT_TOKEN || loadFromKeyring()` — that's the culprit. cache loader then overwrites project-scoped headers with org-level creds.

sam (sdk): hmm, code should be `process.env.PROJECT_TOKEN || process.env.ORG_API_KEY || loadFromKeyring()` per spec. I'm guessing a subtle reorder happened during a refactor.

marco (eng-runtime): is this just CLI, or also the node/python SDKs? If CLI caches an org key in the shared keyring, SDKs reading keyring could also pick it up.

elaine (devex): only repro'd with CLI and the sampleapp which uses the CLI's keyring helper. i did a quick test: `export ORG_API_KEY=org123; export PROJECT_TOKEN=proj456; ./sampleapp run` -> calls were billed to org123 workspace.

sam (sdk): thanks — I'll open a tiny patch to flip precedence and add a unit test. also will update the keyring loader to namespace keys by project id so they don't clobber each other.

jia (platform): +1 on namespacing keyring entries. We should also surface a clear warning when both env vars exist: "Both ORG_API_KEY and PROJECT_TOKEN detected; using PROJECT_TOKEN" so users know we intentionally prefer project-scoped creds.

elaine (devex): that UX message would save a lot of confusion during onboarding. can we also add a devtool that scans common envs and warns in CI?

marco (eng-runtime): low-effort check: add a startup log line in sampleapp and CLI when two conflicting keys are present. If this looks good, we can roll it to the quickstart image.

sam (sdk): created PR: https://git.redwood/sdks/patch/42 — flips precedence, adds keyring namespacing, and a test. leaving TODO for the CLI warning message.

elaine (devex): awesome. once merged, i'll update the quickstart docs and sampleapp container to unset ORG_API_KEY in the Dockerfile so new users don't hit it.

dev-bot: deploy-preview: patch/42 passed CI (unit + integration) and is queued for canary deploy. :rocket:

sam (sdk): thanks everyone. follow-up: we should add a short migration note in the changelog so platform customers using org tokens in their developer machines are aware of precedence flip.

elaine (devex): agreed — i'll draft the blurb and ping eng-docs. closing this thread once PR merged and docs updated. :thumbsup:
